# GET /api/v1/user/applications/oauth2/{id}

Get a specific OAuth2 application by ID

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-170`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | int64 | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — api.OAuth2Application

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Unique identifier |
| `name` | string | Application name |
| `client_id` | string | OAuth2 client ID |
| `client_secret` | string | Always empty string |
| `confidential_client` | bool | Whether client is confidential |
